newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in late trading on Friday with traders expecting bearish market sentiment next week.
"This 'Thailand attack' continues to dampen market sentiment. We expect prices to fall further next week and levels can drop to as low as 44.00 U.S. cents/lb," said one trader.
Traders said they believed the cheaper offer prices in Thailand, as a result of the government's intervention there, had pushed Indonesian prices down.

They said they did not hear any fresh bids and offer prices were unchanged at 45.25 fob Palembang for August/September shipment, 45.75 fob Medan, 45.50 fob Padang and Surabaya and 45.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.

"I think this bearish market sentiment will last for quite a long time. We keep hearing rumours that buyers are coming, but in fact they are only testing the market because they want to buy rubber as cheaply as they can," said another trader.
Traders said they generally ignored developments in Tokyo, which is expected to be dominated by a lingering bearish mood next week.
